text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Three, two, one—

text_block_list.name: Pigeon
text_block_list.text: Hoo! Hoo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No, no! You only chirp after you land on 
my shoulder. Magic requires perfect 
synchronization—

text_block_list.name: Pigeon
text_block_list.text: Hoo--!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah!? Wait!! Come back here--!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oho, my white friend. It seems your friend 
has already spotted you hiding in the 
bushes.

text_block_list.name: Pigeon
text_block_list.text: Hoo.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Earth-san, I'm so sorry! I hope this child 
hasn't been causing you any trouble?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Adagio! If there is any sin here, it is my 
song that enchants all creation.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The little bird was chirping too, saying 
she had been enchanted by my song, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
............Huh? ...Whaaat? Y-You can 
actually understand what this kid is 
saying?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sì! Isn't that right, my white friend?

text_block_list.name: Pigeon
text_block_list.text: Hoo.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: !? How on earth did you...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
A singer harmonizes with the melody to 
create harmony. In other words—you must 
listen to the voice of your friend.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I see...? In any case, staying by their 
side is what's truly important, right...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...A white friend?

text_block_list.name: Pigeon
text_block_list.text: Hoo.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That was a reply, right? Well then, 
right away regarding magic—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fermata! One-sided communication is far 
from harmonioso.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Indeed. To stand close and play 
together... If so—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hearing your voice has cleansed my soul, 
my white-coated friend! Now, let me hear 
more of your melodia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Won't you let my voice guide you and join 
my side?! Together, we shall achieve a 
great feat!

text_block_list.name: Pigeon
text_block_list.text: Hoo! Hoo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! Let's do our best 
together...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If we support one another, we can overcome 
any barrier—even across species—and grow 
together, can't we?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Earth-san, thank you so much—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"No, grazie mille! I've gained a wonderful 
insight!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Mmm, benissimo...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Regardless of the way it was phrased, 
Satono Crown learned the importance of 
standing by someone's side."
